station.Frantseva7.desc: An archive and quarantine facility built by <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> entirely with its own resources, without outside contractors. Officially, the station has since been returned to the ancap system and entered into the asset registry. However, it was from Frantseva-7 that the broadcast known as "Critical Situation" originated — a signal later purged from the <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> network. It was after this transmission that events in the Solar System took a decisive turn.
station.Frantseva7.name: Frantseva-7
station.FrescoPlatforms.desc: Boarding platforms camouflaged as extraction stations. Underneath them is the Fresco research laboratory. There we found information indicating that Dr. Eipschwitz's head was being held in the L-BSA prison.
station.FrescoPlatforms.name: MZ Fresco Platforms
station.Freyja.desc: A dome station above one of the outlets of the subglacial ocean. Through a special gateway, scientists descend and dive into an unfamiliar deep-sea world. It is believed that it was here beneath Freyja that the first signs of extraterrestrial organisms were noticed.
station.Freyja.name: Freyja
station.Frostreach.desc: Coordination, dispatch and radar center. Whoever owns Frostreach Command has access to information about movements in the Main Belt.
station.Frostreach.name: Frostreach Command
station.FullersCore.desc: A small business center that also controls Fuller’s position in orbit and the satellite’s main systems. Owners of all other stations on Fuller are required to pay contributions to the Core owner.
station.FullersCore.name: Fuller Core
station.Galileo.desc: A floating weather station that forecasts thunderstorms. It is equipped with unique reconnaissance drones that “listen” to Jupiter at different altitudes. They detect approaching storms by measuring subtle vibrations.
station.Galileo.name: Galileo
station.GammaHydra.desc: A physical research center for studying different types of radiation. It is also home to a small engineering division that develops personal weapons based on radiation and atomic energy. The corporations that own the center are not trying to get a direct profit from it, but to make as much as possible for the production of such rare weapons.
station.GammaHydra.name: Gamma Hydra 4
station.Gloria.desc: Gloria Terminal is a spaceport that provides launch, landing, refueling, charging and current maintenance for shuttles and interplanetary spacecraft. The terminal is located on the outskirts of Intercity, the only city on Mars that was conceived as a symbol of humanity’s prosperity but ended up half-abandoned, swept by dusty winds and the graveyard of many hopes.
station.Gloria.name: Gloria Terminal
station.Goethe.desc: Goethe-1 is an orbital station, a military academy and a testing ground. Here, you can purchase training courses in tactics, strategy and field support for combat operations. The personnel take pride in the fact that many corporate security service chiefs have undergone training here.
station.Goethe.name: Goethe-1
station.GravityRaimbow.desc: An artificial light fixture suspended on a huge platform in the Callisto sky, a giant micro-sun lamp. Unlike the Mirror-Main station, it does not collect light but creates it. Because of this, it wastes colossal amounts of energy. The lamp is turned on in winter or during long Jupiterian eclipses.
station.GravityRaimbow.name: Gravity's Rainbow
station.HadesTorchlight.desc: A semi-enclosed mining platform set right on the edge of a stable lava lake. Unique minerals that are resistant to high temperatures are mined here. The station's cooling system is a unique masterpiece of engineering.
station.HadesTorchlight.name: Hades Torchlight
station.Hargeysa.desc:
The Tortuga of the 23rd century, built by the pirates themselves. In the hard days after the Great Anarchist Revolution (GAR), the asteroid became a refuge for all those who had no desire to work honestly for the benefit of a free humankind. All sorts of scum came here, and while the Hexarchy was creating the AnCap system, crime and violence took root here. At least, that's how it is presented in the films produced by the many film companies owned by AnCom.

Hargeisa is the gathering point for all illegal groups in the Main Belt and the Outer System.
station.Hargeysa.name: Hargeisa
station.HartsWarehouse.desc: A space where you can rent a warehouse for storing anything. There are warehouses shielded from radiation or any type of waves. The owner of this asset not only receives a good fee for renting out warehouse space, but also for all goods in storage if rental payments are overdue.
station.HartsWarehouse.name: Hart’s Warehouse
station.HeritageStation.desc: Market agents encrypt everything they send to the common network. However, everyone knows that one of the advantages of owning routing stations is the ability to intercept data for subsequent decryption and resale attempts. Heritage Station is the largest routing node in the Inner System. Almost all of the colossal volume of information passing through space from Mercury to the Asteroid Belt is filtered and redirected through Heritage.
station.HeritageStation.name: Heritage
station.HISAres.desc: RealWare is a Hexarchy corporation. The Hexarchy is an informal alliance of six major corporations that contributed to the Great Anarchic Revolution. RealWare is one of the wealthiest hexarchs. This conglomerate deals with virtually everything, but its main source of income is weapons and industrial systems. HIS Ares is stationed near Mars, ready to deploy anywhere in the Solar System to protect the corporation's interests.
station.HISAres.name: HIS Ares
station.HISUnveiled.desc: AnCom is a Hexarchy corporation. Once it specialized solely in media products, but recently it has increased its focus on research. After receiving a transmission to the SBN made on behalf of Tetzclan, AnCom’s HIS Unveiled  was sent to Venus, where it went into orbit around the planet.
station.HISUnveiled.name: HIS Unveiled
station.HISWoodpecker.desc: The CoreWard MG heavy interplanetary spacecraft serves as the corporation's base of operations in the Main Belt and oversees assets on Vesta to ensure rapid intervention and either defense or appropriation.
station.HISWoodpecker.name: HIS Woodpecker
station.HumankindsHope.desc: Once the headquarters of the Hive Corporation, which ceased to exist in the mid-22nd century. This asset is now an auxiliary headquarters and a place for management meetings. It is usually rented out for the same purposes.
station.HumankindsHope.name: Humankinds's Hope Citadel
station.Hypnos.desc: At the very beginning of the space age, people had high hopes for the colonization of Mars. The possibilities of the red planet seemed limitless. All these dreams were destined to be scattered by the dusty winds. Many small colonies still remain from those times. These were originally supposed to become new business and intellectual centers. This also applies to the moons of Mars. The Hypnos-2 colony is a profitable but still extremely provincial asset.
station.Hypnos.name: Hypnos-2
station.IbsaPrison.desc: Prisons are a delicate service. Penitentiary facilities can be found in various places in the Solar System. L-BSA is one of the best-known prisons due to its size and quality of service. According to information recently leaked to the SBN, the prison has special containment facilities related to quasimorphosis.
station.IbsaPrison.name: L-BSA
station.IntercityTradeCenter.desc: Amidst the desert streets of Intercity, covered in a thick layer of reddish dust, stands one truly vibrant building: the Intercity Trade Center. Despite the skepticism towards Mars, substantial profits are to be made here from those seeking fortune on the red planet.
station.IntercityTradeCenter.name: Intercity TC
station.ISSStation.desc: Strict limitations on travel mean that not everyone in the Solar System is permitted to visit Earth. To avoid causing difficulties for its numerous clients, the SBN corporation decided to establish its headquarters in orbit. The ISS Station AES is believed to be based on an ancient orbital station dating back to the state period. Besides serving as SBN's headquarters, the station is an information routing node, ensuring a monopoly on the transfer of information in the Inner System.
station.ISSStation.name: ISS AES
station.Jaffa.desc: A port of Wernher and one of the main ports of the Main Belt. Jaffa receives and dispatches hundreds of spacecraft daily. The station compartments are filled with corporate offices, and the area along the service channels is densely built up with capsule hotels.
station.Jaffa.name: Jaffa
station.Jamame.desc: The second station on Interamnia, besides Hargeisa. Once the Voyage Terminal and the property of the Tianming Corporation, today it is a prize that changes hands between the pirates and the System corporation. When the latter is in charge, the anti-piracy center intercepts spacecraft arriving in Hargeisa, and when the pirates or the Civil Resistance are at the helm, temporary peace is established on the asteroid.
station.Jamame.name: Jamame
station.Jinxing.desc: Orbital factories are the main source of goods in the Solar System. Jinxing-Gongchang II is an old but reliable factory. In addition to standard energy sources, it uses heat from the dense upper layers of Venus' atmosphere.
station.Jinxing.name: Jinxing-Gongchang II
station.JourneyOfFire.desc: An entertainment center providing a unique service. In a radiation-shielded shuttle, you can fly so close to the Sun that its magnetic fields will directly affect your brain. The result is strictly individual: literally anything can happen with your consciousness. Some people experience an encounter with God, some experience their own birth, some banish childhood traumas. The center does not provide security guarantees. For treatment of microtumors, it is recommended to contact a medical facility within a month of travel.
station.JourneyOfFire.name: Journey of Fire
station.Jumpstart.desc: A medium-class spaceport connected to the rail network on Callisto's surface. It serves as a transfer base between the planetary surface and the orbit of Jupiter. It is one of the busiest stations on Callisto.
station.Jumpstart.name: Jumpstart
station.Juphub.desc: A station hanging in a transfer orbit with an unclear status. Extracted gas and energy are transported through it to the large factories of the Inner System. The hub is overgrown with residential modules, warehouses and information collection centers. Life in the Outer System is such that control over Juphub is more important here than owning an entire colony on Mars.
station.Juphub.name: Juphub
station.Kitchen.desc: This is a business center where branches of many corporations operate. True, managers are sent here as if they were being sent into exile. And although many eventually find ways to have fun on Mechta, a business trip like this does not bode well for their career.
station.Kitchen.name: Kitchen
station.Kizzuwatna.desc: A colony located in one of the spacecraft that form Vulcan. A pile of dark slums in the womb of a partially-disassembled HIS. People from here will take any job, so corporations on Mercury have no shortage of cheap labor resources.
station.Kizzuwatna.name: Kizzuwatna
station.Korotsev.desc: The only relatively large surface base under a transparent dome. It is partly engaged in receiving cargo, partly in scientific research on hermetic agriculture in low gravity without sunlight. It is known for its experiments with GMO plants.
station.Korotsev.name: Korotsev 2
station.KrakensHub.desc: The only seaport beyond <color=#FFFEC1>Earth</color>. The station is located on the shore of Kraken Mare, where barges dock to transport resources extracted from the hydrocarbon sea. It is considered one of the most profitable, yet also one of the most dangerous places on Titan.
station.KrakensHub.name: Kraken's Hub
station.Kyoko.desc: This is a large brothel that can satisfy the most demanding tastes.
station.Kyoko.name: Kyoko’s House
station.Labyrinth13.desc: A research colony built into a network of caves linking several craters. The station is notorious for the fact that it must be navigated from memory alone: sensors and maps fail, and signals from the <color=#FFFEC1>Cronus</color> station in orbit never reach the complex.
station.Labyrinth13.name: Labyrinth-13
station.LaCE.desc: LaCE is named after the <color=#FFFEC1>Lewis and Clark Expedition</color>, a symbol of humanity’s capacity to open new frontiers. It is a laboratory proving ground orbiting within the <color=#FFFEC1>Cassini Division</color>. The station hosts experiments on microcurvature and inertial traps for the rapid delivery of heavy cargo. It was built around a spacecraft that reached Neptune back in 2047 on a rescue mission. A century later, the hulk was towed to Saturn and rebuilt.
station.LaCE.name: LaCE
station.LandscronaCenter.desc: A business center housing corporate offices that provide communication with the Earth. These could be described as corporate embassies, but the Hexarchy has declared such language offensive due to the comparison of corporations with old-fashioned states.
station.LandscronaCenter.name: Landskrona Center
station.Lavinium.desc: An underground colony and permanent base for temporary mining operations throughout Vesta. Lavinium has come under the control of the Civil Resistance several times in the past.
station.Lavinium.name: Lavinium
station.Lightbay.desc: A station far away from civilized farms, located in a mountainous area. Rare minerals needed for quantum batteries are mined here. All around are rows of coniferous forests shrouded in fog. Due to its remote location, Lightbay often becomes a haven for various refugees from the Outer System, as well as a testing ground for corporations testing exobiological military equipment.
station.Lightbay.name: Lightbay
station.Lomonosov.desc: A research laboratory, carefully isolated from Kizzuwatna. Here they study the photosphere of the Sun, the phenomenon of magnetism and other fundamental physical phenomena at the forefront of science.
station.Lomonosov.name: Lomonosov
station.LouhiCity.desc: At one time, this city under a geodesic dome consisted only of five-star hotels. These days, the colony looks more like a constant combat zone.
station.LouhiCity.name: Louhi-City
station.Lumina.desc: A mining factory located at the bottom of a deep ravine, in the shadow of one of Ceres's mountains. The extremely high mortality rate among miners has given it a bad reputation.
station.Lumina.name: Lumina
station.MacReady.desc: A base used primarily for glacier exploration. It is located on the border of an ice mass and a highland, where the process of surface cracking is accelerated. Living here is dangerous; failures happen every month.
station.MacReady.name: R. J. MacReady
station.Malmo.desc: The city is located entirely inside Geist, on the inner surface of a huge artificial cave. Malmö is illuminated by a fiber optic thread that is enlaced in the ceiling and emits a powerful light. The station does not have its own port, so the only way to get to and from Malmö is through transport tunnels that connect the city with two others: Vasa and Schwerin.
station.Malmo.name: Malmö
station.Mammoth.desc: Mammoth Terminal is a typical spaceport for cargo shuttles and interplanetary spacecraft. It provides charging, refueling and regular maintenance services. Due to Mercury's mass, even heavy interplanetary spacecraft can land here.
station.Mammoth.name: Mammoth Terminal
station.MechtaShooting.desc: This is the training ground inside Mechta. You can rent it and fulfill any fantasies associated with the use of almost any type of weapon.
station.MechtaShooting.name: Mechta Shooting Range
station.Mirage12.desc: A relay station on polar orbit. It provides communications between the colony and surface expeditions and the rest of the System. Inside the station, a strict quarantine regime is enforced — samples of ice and liquids from <color=#FFFEC1>Enceladus</color> undergo their initial analysis here before being allowed anywhere else.
station.Mirage12.name: Mirage-12
station.MirrorMain.desc: An orbital station that accumulates light and directs it to the surface of Callisto to those who pay for it. New Kent is almost always in alignment, interrupted by proportional cycles of the night.
station.MirrorMain.name: Mirror-Main
station.Mobius.desc: A mining complex stretching along the internal cavity of a deep rift. Iron, nickel and rare metals are mined here. Working conditions are hard and the official security tries to maintain order, but does not hesitate to take direct action to intimidate workers if the current owner demands it.
station.Mobius.name: A. F. Mobius
station.Montgomery.desc: An abandoned lithium mine at the foot of a steep hill. Annagerman’s political peculiarities and its distance from main routes mean that it is well suited for unsavory activities. For example, dangerous laboratories or prisons with nightmarish conditions.
station.Montgomery.name: Montgomery
station.MoonTradeCenter.desc: Moon BC is the tallest skyscraper in New Seattle. It is a residential and working complex. Renting out property here can bring incredible profits to the owner. For this reason, there is a real trade war over ownership of MBC. And often not just a trade war.
station.MoonTradeCenter.name: Moon BC
station.MTZ.desc: MTZ is a real city in a stationary lunar orbit. The convenience and comfort of the modules make them highly attractive rental options, resulting in extremely high income for their owner.
station.MTZ.name: MTZ
station.NewKent.desc: A colony with farmland that supplies GMO food for the entire Jupiter system. It is easy to maintain and brings good income to its owners, but is subject to attacks by competitors eager to seize this source of food.
station.NewKent.name: New Kent
station.Nox.desc: A station attached to the back of a large mirror. The station directly controls the rotation of the mirror, and also houses residential and industrial sectors. The mirror itself is used to collect sunlight and illuminate assets on Ceres whose owners are willing to pay for the service.
station.Nox.name: Nox
station.Oddibjord.desc: Most colonies on Venus are located under geodesic domes. This is partly necessary in order to cool and discharge the atmosphere, and partly to contain highly invasive GMO flora and fauna. Oddibjord-3 is a geodesic dome owned by the Fresco concern. It has been seriously damaged by a series of mysterious events. There is information in the SBN that something terrible is happening on the underground levels of the colony.
station.Oddibjord.name: Oddibjord-3
station.Oracle.desc: Former Civil Resistance base. After the Oracle was cleared of colnodes by the joint efforts of the security services of several corporations, the station changed hands and is essentially ownerless.
station.Oracle.name: Oracle Bastion
station.Origin.desc: Once a small mining base that extracted frozen methane from beneath the surface, it became a major facility when large deposits of platinum were discovered here.
station.Origin.name: Origin
station.OrkneyIslands.desc: AnCom base on the Orkney Islands. A secret gathering site of the Inner Rite on Earth. Geoscanners indicate that beneath the bunker entrance lies a multi-level complex, along with a shaft whose vertical bore descends several kilometers into the Earth’s crust.
station.OrkneyIslands.name: Orkney
station.Orphan.desc: Orphan Mining Base is a mining facility on Phobos. Eternal twilight, a suspension of dust, hard work in spacesuits—all of this awaits workers here. For some, this is a way of starting a working career if they fail to pay for an education, while for others it is a platform for campaigning against the New Corporate Ethics.
station.Orphan.name: Orphan
station.Paragon.desc: Paragon FC is an ancient factory that still runs on atomic energy. Such factories are now rare in the System. Nevertheless, this industrial workhorse provides its owner with sufficient profits.
station.Paragon.name: Paragon FC
station.Patton.desc: The Patton mine is situated on a natural lithium conduit that goes very, very deep into the asteroid. The conduit is relatively narrow, so underneath Patton is a vertical shaft several kilometers deep. The working conditions there are unbearable due to the natural features of the asteroid. Workers constantly hear noises and groans coming from behind the walls.
station.Patton.name: Patton
station.Pedigree.desc: A “flying palace” built by the Dilthey Corporation as a fashionable vacation spot for the System's wealthy. However, the Main Belt never became popular with the corporate bigwigs, so Pedigree Station became a mid-level residential station near Ceres.
station.Pedigree.name: Pedigree
station.Pertwee.desc: A station commissioned by <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color>, serving as the traffic control hub for safe passage through Saturn’s rings. The station’s owner manages the “green corridors” across the dense regions of the A/B Rings and conducts auctions for priority transit slots for transporting of ice boulders.
station.Pertwee.name: Pertwee
station.Phenomenon.desc: Residential and work areas are a highly profitable business in the Solar System. Once you build, buy, or otherwise acquire such a location, you start receiving an inexhaustible stream of rental dividends. The orbital city of Phenomenon fully lives up to its name. The masts of docking berths, stretching out in all directions from bulky modules, give the city the appearance of a ball of spaghetti hanging in space.
station.Phenomenon.name: Phenomenon
station.Phoebe1.desc: A colony built inside a crater, its walls shielding it from meteorite strikes and concealing it from direct orbital observation. Here are located fuel depots and shelters for transports seeking a place to remain in long-term dock.
station.Phoebe1.name: Phoebe-1
station.Photosphere.desc: A hydroponic farm that uses solar energy and radiation to produce advanced GMO plants. If you eat something vegan anywhere in the System, then the raw materials most likely came from Photosphere-17.
station.Photosphere.name: Photosphere-17
station.PilgrimsRift.desc: A colony on the edge of a deep crater. Its name stuck after a series of scientific expeditions that crossed the valley in search of the so-called "source of background oscillations" — a local anomaly. The anomaly was never found, but the mad scientists willing to set out on foot through the labyrinths of <color=#FFFEC1>Hyperion</color> gave the station both its name and something resembling a local cult of pilgrims.
station.PilgrimsRift.name: Pilgrim's Rift
station.PineGapTraining.desc: Pine Gap Training Center is the oldest sociological laboratory in the Solar System. It also houses a large educational center where you can purchase educational services for training managers and psychologists.
station.PineGapTraining.name: Pine Gap
station.PintadoPetrel.desc: A tourist cluster for extreme sports enthusiasts. Shuttles with special protection dive into the lower clouds of Jupiter, where the pressure increases dozens of times over. Many consider such a tourist service to be suicidal. It is very popular.
station.PintadoPetrel.name: Pintado Petrel
station.PlatosAcademy.desc: An educational institution for wealthy families. Here you cannot get an engineering or working education; they don’t teach management theory here. All the Academy can provide is a classical education for the AnCap aristocratic class.
station.PlatosAcademy.name: Plato Academy
station.PointShadow.desc: A digital archive cut off from the global network. It offers archival storage and absolute data encryption services. Among the staff, the phrase "consul’s shift" has taken root — a term for those rare duty rotations when personnel can mind their own business instead of patching yet another breach caused by incoming debris.
station.PointShadow.name: Point Shadow
station.Polaris.desc: A polar energy complex mounted on aerostat platforms above Saturn’s North Pole. It harvests power from the planet’s radio storms and transmits it to buyers using an experimental microwave charge transfer technology.
station.Polaris.name: Polaris
